metadata.accuracy: schematic — these are political claims, drawn to show that they overlap, not to represent submitted coordinates

properties.name: Russian extended shelf submission
properties.note: Russia claims the Lomonosov and Mendeleev ridges as natural prolongations of its continental shelf, which would carry its seabed rights across the pole. Submitted to the UN shelf commission; overlapping with Danish and Canadian claims.

properties.name: Danish (Greenland) shelf submission
properties.note: Denmark filed a claim on Greenland’s behalf covering the Lomonosov Ridge beyond the pole — the largest of the Arctic submissions and directly overlapping Russia’s.

properties.name: Canadian shelf submission
properties.note: Canada’s submission also runs along the Lomonosov Ridge toward the pole. Separately, Canada treats the Northwest Passage as internal waters, which the United States disputes.
